en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large circular fountain complex with several jets of water in a rectangular basin labeled 'Kleine Leuchtfontäne'. Numerous empty folding chairs are arranged in rows in the foreground, suggesting performances or displays. People stroll around the fountain and across a broad plaza. In the background stands a long low pavilion building with large windows, café tables with umbrellas on a terrace, and an extended colonnade to the right. Beyond are residential houses and trees. Handwritten at the top is the word 'Dusseldorf', and there is a round exhibition-style stamp in the upper right.
